# Design ladder

## Associate {#associate}

Designs a well-scoped screen with guidance, and explains the choices in it.

## Designer {#designer}

Owns a feature from problem to shipped design, and changes it when the evidence says so.

## Senior {#senior}

Shapes what the team builds, not only how it looks, and shows it moved a number.

## Lead {#lead}

Sets direction across teams, and changes other people's roadmaps with evidence.
